premises.text: Customized instant manicures are a hassle for girls like Kendall
premises.evidence_span: getting a customized instant manicure is a hassle. Going to a nail salon is extremely inconvenient. It's also pretty pricey.

premises.text: The Nailbot can print custom instant nail art directly onto fingernails using a smartphone
premises.evidence_span: Nailbot prints custom instant nail art directly onto your fingernail using your smartphone.

premises.text: The Nailbot utilizes thermal inkjet technology for printing nail art
premises.evidence_span: We are utilizing Hewlett-Packard thermal inkjet technology in our early Nailbot solutions.

premises.text: The Nailbot prints images quickly and can be easily removed
premises.evidence_span: printing in just a few seconds. This art is also easily removed with traditional nail polish remover.

premises.text: There is a significant market of tween and teen girls who regularly decorate their nails
premises.evidence_span: 21 million girls strong in the United States, 92% of which decorate their nails regularly.

value.text: Girls can express themselves creatively through customized nail art
